def entry(s:readbuf, o:mutbuf, w:mutbuf) -> u32:
    if length(s) < 24 or load(s, 0) != 3616443570523558472 or load(s, 8) != 1:
        return old_entry(s, o, w)
    if length(o) < 32:
        return 4294967294
    if length(w) < 4096:
        return grow(o, 1, 4096)
    mode = load(s, 16)
    if length(s) != 24 or mode > 1:
        return 4294967295
    size = target_size(mode)
    if size > length(o) - 32:
        return grow(o, 2, 32 + size)
    target_literal(o, 32, mode)
    return finish(o, size)

def target_size(mode:u64) -> u64:
    if mode == 0:
        return 9646
    return 9703

def target_literal(o:mutbuf, at:u64, mode:u64) -> u64:
    if mode == 0:
        prefix_0(o, at)
        common_literal(o, at + 11)
        return 0
    if mode == 1:
        prefix_1(o, at)
        common_literal(o, at + 68)
        return 0
    return 0

def common_literal(o:mutbuf, at:u64) -> u64:
    common_0(o, at + 0)
    common_512(o, at + 512)
    common_1024(o, at + 1024)
    common_1536(o, at + 1536)
    common_2048(o, at + 2048)
    common_2560(o, at + 2560)
    common_3072(o, at + 3072)
    common_3584(o, at + 3584)
    common_4096(o, at + 4096)
    common_4608(o, at + 4608)
    common_5120(o, at + 5120)
    common_5632(o, at + 5632)
    common_6144(o, at + 6144)
    common_6656(o, at + 6656)
    common_7168(o, at + 7168)
    common_7680(o, at + 7680)
    common_8192(o, at + 8192)
    common_8704(o, at + 8704)
    common_9216(o, at + 9216)
    return 0

    return 0

def old_entry(s:readbuf, o:mutbuf, w:mutbuf) -> u32:
    if length(o) < 32:
        return 4294967294
    if length(w) < 4096:
        return grow(o, 1, 4096)
    if length(s) < 24 or load(s, 0) != 3616443570523558472:
        return 4294967295
    op = load(s, 8)
    arg = load(s, 16)
    if op == 4:
        if arg != length(s) - 24 or arg < 2 or byte(s, 24) != 34 or byte(s, length(s) - 1) != 34:
            return 4294967295
        prefix = old_size(10)
        suffix = old_size(11)
        if arg > 18446744073709551583 - prefix - suffix:
            return grow(o, 3, 0)
        size = prefix + arg + suffix
        if size > length(o) - 32:
            return grow(o, 2, 32 + size)
        old_literal(o, 32, 10)
        copy_range(o, s, 32 + prefix, 24, arg)
        old_literal(o, 32 + prefix + arg, 11)
        return finish(o, size)
    if length(s) != 24:
        return 4294967295
    if op == 6:
        if arg < 1 or arg > 8:
            return 4294967295
        if length(o) < 512:
            return grow(o, 2, 512)
        at = length(w) - 4096
        put(w, at, 32)
        put(w, at + 8, 0)
        protocol_suffix(o, w, arg)
        if get(w, at + 8) != 0:
            return 4294967295
        return finish(o, get(w, at) - 32)
    which = 0
    if op == 2 and arg >= 1 and arg <= 4:
        which = arg + 1
    elif op == 3 and arg >= 1 and arg <= 3:
        which = arg + 6
    elif op == 5 and arg <= 1:
        which = arg + 12
    if which == 0:
        return 4294967295
    size = old_size(which)
    if size > length(o) - 32:
        return grow(o, 2, 32 + size)
    old_literal(o, 32, which)
    return finish(o, size)

def old_literal(o:mutbuf, at:u64, which:u64) -> u64:
    if which == 2:
        retained_literal_2(o, at)
        return old_size(2)
    if which == 3:
        retained_literal_3(o, at)
        return old_size(3)
    if which == 4:
        retained_literal_4(o, at)
        return old_size(4)
    if which == 5:
        retained_literal_5(o, at)
        return old_size(5)
    if which == 6:
        retained_literal_6(o, at)
        return old_size(6)
    if which == 7:
        retained_literal_7(o, at)
        return old_size(7)
    if which == 8:
        retained_literal_8(o, at)
        return old_size(8)
    if which == 9:
        retained_literal_9(o, at)
        return old_size(9)
    if which == 10:
        retained_literal_10(o, at)
        return old_size(10)
    if which == 11:
        retained_literal_11(o, at)
        return old_size(11)
    if which == 12:
        retained_literal_12(o, at)
        return old_size(12)
    if which == 13:
        retained_literal_13(o, at)
        return old_size(13)
    return 0
